title: Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve: Recording the Annual Hazard Premium on Review
content:
Set-Aside Accounts hold an annual hazard premium on every Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve. This rule sets the annual hazard premium held on a Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve, called here the projected annual hazard premium, whenever the hazard insurance bills on file are reviewed.

> For a Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve, and only for such a reserve, the annual hazard premium held on file is the projected annual hazard premium rather than the billed amount of the current hazard policy term; the annual hazard premium of every other set-aside remains under the general annual-charges rule of Set-Aside Accounts.

### Transaction reference — `update_reserve_hazard_5ea539e7`

- **Owner and access:** agent-side; the servicing agent unlocks the tool and then calls it.
- **Effect:** records a new annual hazard insurance premium on a Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve after a review of the hazard insurance bills on file. The annual hazard premium held on the reserve is replaced with the figure supplied; the reserve balance, its ledger, the bills on file and the annual property tax and flood premium are left unchanged. Afterwards the reserve shows the new annual hazard premium to anyone who looks it up.
- **Input `setaside_id`:** reference number of the Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve whose annual hazard premium is replaced, as the set-aside account lookup returns it for the loan. Identifier.
- **Input `setaside_request_id`:** reference number of the hazard insurance bill on file that the review relied on, as the set-aside bills and requests lookup returns it for that reserve. Identifier.
- **Input `annual_hazard_premium`:** the annual hazard premium to hold on the reserve; USD, 2 decimal places, a positive amount already rounded to the cent before the call.
- **Output:** `status` — "updated" when the figure was recorded; `setaside_id`; `setaside_request_id` — the bill relied on; `previous_annual_hazard_premium` — the premium held before the call; `annual_hazard_premium` — the premium now held; amounts to 2 decimal places.
